status: frozen before the first campaign call; committed by the owner alongside the Day 1 gate records (ROADMAP decisions 13 & 15)

task_list.source: data/slices/slice-v1.json (seed 20260902, frame and full candidate order recorded there)

run_order.rule: tasks in slice-v1.json order (difficulty asc, then name); per task, hy3-terminus-2 then hy3-mini-swe-agent (config-interleaved so neither config systematically runs later in the day)
run_order.concurrency: n-concurrent 2 locally, identical for both configs; identical harbor flags across all runs; single attempt per (task, config)

substitution_rule_verbatim: Sole exception: a run invalidated by measurement failure (Docker/API infrastructure, marked `inconclusive` with the broken attempt kept on record) may be re-run once — apparatus failures are re-measurable, disliked results are not.

quota_plan.measured_baseline: 69,401 tokens for the Day 1 live trial (fix-git, easy, clean 15-step solve)
quota_plan.projection: ~12M for 40 campaign agent runs; ~16-18M central including judge lanes; <=35M worst case
quota_plan.policy: quota is not a constraint (owner-confirmed); owner tops up on request; scope never silently trimmed for quota

blinding_protocol.verdict_suppression: the evaluation script suppresses verdicts by default; printing one requires an explicit --show-verdict
blinding_protocol.labels: the annotation CLI records each initial human label with a timestamp before any evaluator output is revealed
blinding_protocol.reviews: append-only versions; any non-blinded review is marked as such and excluded from validation metrics by construction

judge_plan.freeze: rubric-v1 + prompt-v1 frozen on Day 5, before any campaign call; judge = hy3, lowest temperature, fixed reasoning effort, configured separately from the agent
judge_plan.stability: five judge-stability sessions on the invalid fixture (Day 5 gate) + five on one real flagged run and one consistency session per campaign run (Day 7) — decision 12 instrument-measurement carve-out

notes: fix-git also served as the Day 1 live gate trial; that trial is an environment-check record, never campaign evidence — the campaign run of fix-git is a fresh single attempt
gate failures excluded by viability, recorded in day1-task-gate.json: build-cython-ext, caffe-cifar-10, qemu-alpine-ssh, qemu-startup
heavy tasks (sam-cell-seg, video-processing, portfolio-optimization) stay in — the frame does not exclude by runtime; wall-clock risk is accepted and the ROADMAP cut order is the pressure valve
